snippet.title: PC Engine Longplay [249] Galaxy Keiji Gayvan
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: NPI

A good beat em up. You can play either as Mittchi or Gayvan (I chose the girl; let's just say I like her more :P). It doesn't matter as the story is the same no matter who you choose.

You can also fight against each other (Omake Vs.), which I included at the end of the video -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
